summary: BugsV2 Batch #4 verified end-to-end on preview backend + frontend. All 4 fixes work correctly and the 2 pytest regressions pass. (1) Bug #78 Vendor Document Crossover: pytest test_bug78_admin_create_rejects_cross_email_draft passes — admin-create refuses to import document_slots from a draft whose email doesn't match the new vendor. AdminVendorCreate.jsx update() also correctly resets draftId/draftToken/document_slots when reg.email is changed (Playwright verified: after createDraft with vendorX@example.com the admin-vendor-draft-banner appears; on typing different@example.com the banner disappears and admin-vendor-nodraft-banner shows). (2) Notices admin panel: pytest test_notices_admin_all_returns_drafts passes on /api/v1/notices/admin/all. Frontend NoticesPanel now uses adminApi.listAllNotices — Playwright created a notice with 'Publish immediately' unchecked and the newly-created TESTDRAFT-* title appeared in the list within one refresh cycle. (3) Registrations panel auto-switch: after clicking Approve on a submitted registration, the reg-filter-approved tab became active (bg-brand-navy + text-white classes) while reg-filter-submitted lost the active style — confirms decide() sets nextStatus and calls setStatus. (4) Tender Builder list refresh after delete: cloned master → renamed to TESTTPL-* → saved → deleted; the deleted TESTTPL-* is no longer in the list. Cache-buster _=Date.now() in tenderTemplateApi.list is present.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — dev-only warning, but noisy in the console. Consider rendering plain text (no wrapping span) inside <option> children.

critical_code_review_comments: vendor_full_invite.py line 104 compares draft.email vs email using .lower() on draft only if draft.email exists — email variable is already lowercased upstream, but a defensive .lower() on both sides would be more explicit; current code is correct but relies on caller lowercasing.

NoticesPanel.jsx load() ignores errors silently (.catch(() => {}) style) — if the admin/all endpoint 500s the panel just shows empty; consider surfacing an error toast so users know why drafts are missing.

RegistrationsPanel.jsx decide() uses r?.status as the source of truth for nextStatus fallback — good; but if backend returns 200 with no status field (e.g. a 204-style change), the fallback branch will still call setStatus(status), which is a no-op. Acceptable, just noting.

tenderTemplateApi.list adds _=Date.now() query param — this works around CloudFront caching but pollutes server logs with unique URLs. On self-hosted CDN prefer setting a Cache-Control: no-store response header on that route.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test notices (TESTDRAFT-*), 1 test template (TESTTPL-*, then deleted), 1 submitted registration approved as part of workflow test. All safe additive test data prefixed TEST/TESTDRAFT/TESTTPL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch #4 fixes are green on preview. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_regression_v22.py, results at /app/test_reports/pytest/regression_v22_results.xml. Admin tabs are simple <button> elements with uppercase text ('NOTICES', 'REGISTRATIONS', 'TENDER BUILDER', ...) — use page.locator('button:has-text("NAME")').first.click(). Notice create requires notice-title (>=3), notice-description (>=10), notice-category (INPUT, free text works — e.g. 'goods'), and notice-deadline (datetime-local, format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'). Tender Builder flow to test delete: click 'CLONE AS DRAFT' → tb-name & tb-save appear → save → tb-delete appears on the editing form. Admin/all notices endpoint: GET /api/v1/notices/admin/all?limit=200. There is a pre-existing React dev-warning about <span> inside <option> in AnalyticsPanel (line 96) — cosmetic dev-only, not blocking.
